segments.ja326:1.1: Kāyena yo nāvahare, vācāya na musā bhaṇe;
segments.ja326:1.3: Yaso laddhā na majjeyya, sa ve kakkārumarahati.
segments.ja326:2.1: Dhammena vittameseyya, na nikatyā dhanaṃ hare;
segments.ja326:2.3: Bhoge laddhā na majjeyya, sa ve kakkārumarahati.
segments.ja326:3.1: Yassa cittaṃ ahāliddaṃ, saddhā ca avirāginī;
segments.ja326:3.3: Eko sāduṃ na bhuñjeyya, sa ve kakkārumarahati.
segments.ja326:4.1: Sammukhā vā tirokkhā vā [parokkhā vā (pī.), parammukhā (ka.)], yo sante na paribhāsati;
